items.title: GPN Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Genius Growth, Margins Rise
items.summary: Global Payments tops Q3 earnings estimates, driven by strong Genius adoption and higher enterprise volumes, while expanding margins and progress on Worldpay integration support growth.

items.title: Will a ‘blue wave’ push the CCCA?
items.summary: With Sen. Roger Marshall voted out and Sen. Dick Durbin retiring, the Credit Card Competition Act faces an uncertain future.

items.title: Mastercard Stock Rose 22% in a Month. Here’s What Its Price Now Assumes
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMastercard (MA:NYSE) stock is up 19% in the past month and is at a 52-week high after a Q3 report that beat on revenue. Most of the gain came from a higher multiple, because Wall Street’s earnings estimates barely moved after the report.

items.title: Visa's Solid Q4 Masks Rising Incentives: Is V Still Worth Buying?
items.summary: V's Q4 earnings beat and surging value-added services signal strength, but rising client incentives and a premium valuation cloud the case for buying now.

items.title: Visa Just Raised Its Dividend 16%. Is It a Better Buy Than Mastercard?
items.summary: Both payments giants just rallied double digits after earnings, yet their yields sit below 1%. The real contest hides in dividend growth, buyback firepower, and what each stock charges you for growth. Which one fits your timeline?

items.title: Mastercard Got Targets Up to $765 After Q3. Why One Firm Still Says Hold at $535
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMore than a dozen firms raised their Mastercard price targets after its third-quarter beat. Five of them run from Monness’s $535 with a Hold to Cantor Fitzgerald’s $765 with an Overweight.

items.title: Mastercard Soars 10% in a Week to a Record. Its CFO’s Warning: “A Similar Offset in Q4”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMastercard stock rose 10% in a week to a record. The run began with 14% revenue growth and ended the day after a Senate author of the swipe-fee bill, which also hangs over Visa, lost his seat.
